May 27, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Wellcome Trust Ltd decreased its stake in Facebook Inc (FB) by 9.89% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Wellcome Trust Ltd sold 200,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.82 million shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $321.71 million, down from 2.02 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wellcome Trust Ltd who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $535.28B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.54% or $1.01 during the last trading session, reaching $184.92. About 10.97 million shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 8.48% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 3.07% the S&P500.
